== 1st Quest ==
{| {{prettytable}}
! || A || B || C || D
|-
! width="4%" | 1
|width="24%"|A very special shop is hidden beneath the middle {{im/loz|Enemy|Armos}} in the top row.  In this unique store, you can buy a {{im/loz|Item|Key}} for 80 rupees, the one of a kind {{im/loz|Item|Blue Ring}} for 250 rupees, or the {{im/loz|Item|Monster Bait}} for a cheap 60 rupees.
!width="72%" colspan="3" | ''See [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 5|Section 5]]''
|-
! 2
|In this cave you will find a shop that sells (the ability to use) {{im/loz|Item|Arrows}} for 80 rupees, the {{im/loz|Item|Magical Shield}} for 130 rupees and a set of 4 {{im/loz|Item|Bombs}} for 20 rupees.
|width="24%"|If you take the {{im/loz|Item|Raft}} from the dock below, you will arrive here at the entrance to the [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 1/Dungeon 4|fourth dungeon]].
|width="24%"|The tree located in the top left corner can be burned down to reveal a very convenient store which sells the {{im/loz|Item|Magical Shield}} for 90 rupees, {{im/loz|Item|Monster Bait}} for 100 rupees, or an ordinary {{im/loz|Item|Heart}} for 10 rupees.
|width="24%"|Burn down a tree along the top row towards the right side of the area to reveal a stairwell which leads to a {{im/loz|Item|Heart Container}}.
|-
! 3
|
|If you have the {{im/loz|Item|Raft}}, you can use the dock here to launch to the area above.
|Burn down the lower solitary tree to find a stairwell where you can receive 10 {{im/loz|Item|Rupees}}.
|
|-
! 4
|In this cave lives a medicine woman.  If you have shown her the {{im/loz|Item|Letter}}, she will sell you the {{im/loz|Item|2nd Potion}} for 68 rupees and the {{im/loz|Item|Water of Life}} for 40 rupees.
|
|Walk in to the cave to find a shop which sells the {{im/loz|Item|Magical Shield}} for 160 rupees, a {{im/loz|Item|Key}} for 100 rupees, or the {{im/loz|Item|Blue Candle}} for 60 rupees.
|Bomb the north wall directly over the southern path to reveal a cave where you can receive 30 {{im/loz|Item|Rupees}}.
|-
! 5
!''See [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 8|Section 8]]''
|If you reach the cave, you can enter it and talk to a woman inside for some useful information about the cemetery.
|Bomb along the middle of the north wall to expose a cave that leads to the Money Making Game.
|'''Starting Point''': You begin your adventures here.  Walk in to the cave to receive the {{im/loz|Item|Wooden Sword}}, your very first weapon.
|}

! width="4%" | 1

!width="72%" colspan="3" | ''See [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 5|Section 5]]''

|
|Walk in to the cave to find a shop which sells the {{im/loz|Item|Magical Shield}} for 160 rupees, a {{im/loz|Item|Key}} for 100 rupees, or the {{im/loz|Item|Blue Candle}} for 60 rupees.
